You can return the answer in any order.

sampleProblems.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
sampleProblems.description:
You are given an array prices where prices[i] is the price of a given stock on the ith day.

You want to maximize your profit by choosing a single day to buy one stock and a different day in the future to sell that stock.

Return the maximum profit you can achieve from this transaction. If you cannot achieve any profit, return 0.

examples.explanation: Buy on day 2 (price=1) and sell on day 5 (price=6), profit = 6-1 = 5
No transaction occurred, best you can do is hold (profit = 0)

columns.title: TEXT NOT NULL
columns.examples: JSONB (array of objects with input, output, explanation)
columns.test_cases: JSONB (array of objects with input, output, notes)
columns.starter_code: JSONB (object with python, javascript, cpp, java keys)
columns.companies: TEXT[] or JSONB (array of company names)
columns.hints: TEXT[] or JSONB (array of hint strings)

validationRules: description must be at least 50 characters
difficulty must be one of: Easy, Medium, Hard
pattern must be from the approved list (25+ patterns)
constraints array must have at least 2 items
companies array must have at least 1 company
examples array must have at least 2 examples
each example must have: input, output, explanation
test_cases array must have at least 3 test cases
each test case must have: input, output, notes
function_name must match language naming conventions
time_complexity should follow Big O notation
space_complexity should follow Big O notation

seedingProcess.step2: Merge with basic metadata from dsaProblems.js
seedingProcess.step3: Validate all fields against validation rules
seedingProcess.step5: Batch insert problems (50 per batch) to Supabase
seedingProcess.step7: Test sample queries for each pattern

backend.returns: Complete problem object with all fields

migrationPath.approach: Batch extend PROBLEM_DATA array in seedProblems.js
migrationPath.timeline: 1-2 weeks for data collection and entry
